lead.event: Astrindo reports nine-month results and maintains its 2026 revenue target
lead.headline: BIPI reports 34.23% nine-month revenue drop, keeps US$140 million 2026 target
lead.blurb: Astrindo reported January-September revenue of US$128.13 million, down 34.23% year on year, and net profit of US$5.51 million after a US$5.41 million loss a year earlier. It maintained its target of approximately US$140 million in revenue by the end of 2026. The company is expanding across Mini LNG, waste-to-energy and geothermal-powered data centers, including a 2.5 mmscfd plant in Wunut targeted for completion in the second quarter of 2027.

other.event: Adhi Karya responds to a PKPU petition
other.headline: ADHI responds to PKPU petition filed by two companies
other.blurb: Atap Perkasa and Satek Aire Indonesia registered the petition at the Central Jakarta Commercial Court on 17 November. Adhi Karya says it has not received official court notice and will verify the petition’s basis once it arrives. The company says the petition has no significant impact on its operations, financial condition or business continuity.

deals_control.event: AKR acquires the remaining stake in Aneka Petroindo Raya
deals_control.headline: AKRA acquires Aneka Petroindo Raya’s remaining 49.9% for US$14.22 million
deals_control.blurb: The purchase from BP Global Investments Limited took effect on 6 November, raising AKR’s ownership of APR from 50.1% to 100%. AKR said the deal has no material impact because APR was already consolidated, with the main changes to profit attribution and consolidated equity.

deals_control.event: Dharma Polimetal partners with Minth Group on EV components
deals_control.headline: DRMA partners Minth Group on EV components through Rp180 billion JV
deals_control.blurb: Dharma Polimetal established the joint venture in September 2026 to supply EV components, particularly aluminium extrusion for chassis and body structures. The project is part of the company's Rp400 billion capital expenditure plan for 2026.

earnings_guidance.event: Timah reports Rp4.12 trillion in nine-month net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: TINS reports Rp4.12 trillion in nine-month net profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: Timah’s revenue rose 144% year on year to Rp16.15 trillion, supported by increased ore supply and stronger global tin prices. Tin ore output reached 18,893 tons by September, and the company targets 25,000 tons for full-year 2026.

capital_raising_buybacks.headline: PRDA completes 2026 buyback of 36.14 million shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Prodia repurchased the shares for Rp112.42 billion, including transaction costs, at an average Rp3,033 each during a program that ran from 20 August to 19 November. Its treasury holdings now total 83.86 million shares, or 8.95% of paid-up capital, below the 20% maximum.
